text:
Marco T: Noticed a surge of 502/504 and connection retries across regions during last night's cert rotation. Looks correlated with dual-stack (IPv6/IPv4) resolver divergence and a leftover old A record in RoutePool-B. Opening this thread for follow-ups and owners.
Nisha S: Is there a clear window? Any specific routesets or clusters affected?
Marco T: Spike 23:40-23:55 UTC. Mostly eu-west1 -> us-west2 traffic. RoutePool-B sticky mappings to v4 addresses lingered while v6 answers propagated differently.
Omar L: Preliminary triage: some regional resolvers returned AAAA only while others returned mixed A+AAAA; LBs chose endpoints w/o proper cert binding for SNI in a few cases -> TLS handshake errors.
PlatformEng: Suggested immediate actions: 1) emergency ingress cache invalidation for RoutePool-B, 2) add resolver parity checks to pre-deploy CI, 3) tighten authoritative TTLs for cert rollouts, 4) create long-term remediation ticket for dual-stack rollout playbooks.
Nisha S: I'll take #1. Adding an emergency runbook entry to Platform Runbooks with exact commands and verification steps. ETA: 6h.
Omar L: I'll own #2 and #3. Plan: small CI job that queries regional resolvers (A/AAAA) and compares endpoint lists; fail deploy if mismatch > 2 endpoints. Also propose standardizing SOA refresh logic. ETA: EOD.
Marco T: @infra-bot can we kick a canary job in eu-west1 after the runbook changes? Want to validate both v4 and v6 paths.
infra-bot: Canary launched: canary-dualstack-2026-03-26-01:30 (eu-west1). Posting health results to this thread.
SRE Oncall: Quick verification snippets for manual checks:
```
# check region resolver answers
dig +short lb.routepool-b.redwood.internal A @ns1.eu-west1
dig +short lb.routepool-b.redwood.internal AAAA @ns1.eu-west1
# curl via ipv6/ipv4 with SNI to validate cert
curl -6 -v --resolve lb.routepool-b.redwood.internal:443:[2001:db8::4] https://lb.routepool-b.redwood.internal/health
curl -4 -v --resolve lb.routepool-b.redwood.internal:443:10.4.5.6 https://lb.routepool-b.redwood.internal/health
```
PlatformEng: Created NET-469: "dual-stack resolver parity & cert-rollout guardrails". Owner: Omar L. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-469
Nisha S: Runbook snippet added with flush command and rollback steps: `./infra/flush-ingress --pool routepool-b --force && ./infra/verify-ingress --pool routepool-b`
Omar L: PoC resolver parity job: will push a lightweight agent that queries regional NS, compares A/AAAA sets, emits metric `dns.resolver.parity` and alerts when deviation > 1 minute. PR will reference branch: platform/dns-parity. ETA PR: tomorrow.
Marco T: Owners recap:
- Nisha S: emergency ingress invalidation runbook + verification steps 16h
- Omar L: CI parity checks + TTL recommendations + NET-469 12h for PR, roll to CI EOD
- PlatformEng: create canonical cert-rollout checklist and include dual-stack checks days
- SRE Oncall: monitor canary and the new `dns.resolver.parity` metric for 72h
SRE Oncall: Canary early results: 5/5 health checks passing over 15m, no TLS errors observed. Continuing to monitor for 48h.
Nisha S: Adding a recurring 6-week cadence item to the platform health review to look for recurring resolver mismatch patterns. Ticket REF: NET-469-REVIEWS.
Marco T: Thanks everyone. We'll use this thread as the action tracker; ping me if anything regresses. Closing initial actions but keeping thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
